integrity_amendments.reason: The original 18-hour purge covered only the future outcome horizon. Strict split independence must cover the complete 168-bar causal input plus the 72-bar label horizon, so the embargo is 60 hours and evaluation uses the earliest event from each connected full-exposure dependency block.

owner_authorization.request: 我觉得模型检测出来的看起来还不错 但是看全局图却不咋样 你觉得应该怎么办 开启L2判断层？开启目标模式去做吧
owner_authorization.interpreted_scope: Build and validate a research-only L2 judgment layer that receives frozen L1 proposals and uses only globally contextual numeric features available at the detector window close. Train and select the score gate on pre-holdout data only, compare L1-only versus L1-plus-L2 on a final pre-holdout validation period, and render kept/rejected full-context charts. Do not promote, deploy, mutate ACTIVE/frozen/forward state, send Telegram, or place orders.

question: Can a causal L2 ranker remove L1 proposals whose local box looks right but whose 168-bar global context is poor, while retaining economically useful proposals out of time?
single_variable: L1-only proposal pool versus the same frozen L1 pool filtered by one preregistered L2 score threshold; L1 weights, L1 inference geometry, outcome contract and trading cost remain fixed.

source.l1_training_interval_overlap_policy: Exclude a proposal when its visible input interval intersects any positive or negative image interval in the frozen L1 training manifest for the same symbol.
source.survivorship_disclosure: The 54 long-history symbols are a current available-file cohort, not a point-in-time exchange universe. The matched control and all comparisons use this identical cohort.

decision_clock.window_end_time_semantics: open timestamp of the final 15m bar visible to L1
decision_clock.available_at: window_end_time plus 15 minutes, after the final visible bar closes
decision_clock.l2_feature_row: the final visible bar at window_end_time
decision_clock.entry: open of the bar at available_at
decision_clock.completed_shape_research_only: L1 already consumes 2-9 bars after the mapped core. This experiment evaluates its existing completed-shape contract and is not a tip/tip-1/tip-2 production signal.

outcome.side: use frozen L1 class; dense_long=long and dense_short=short

l2.score_gate: 90th percentile of tune scores; freeze before final validation
l2.missing_values: native LightGBM missing-value handling; no future fill
l2.single_feature_baseline: same LightGBM regression protocol using ma_spread_pct only

splits.grouping_unit: earliest event in each connected same-symbol full-exposure dependency block

dependency_contract.event_exposure_start: available_at minus 168 bars (42 hours), covering the first open timestamp visible to the 168-bar L2 context
dependency_contract.event_exposure_end_exclusive: available_at plus 72 bars (18 hours), covering the complete label path
dependency_contract.connected_component_rule: within each same-symbol learning split, half-open exposure intervals that overlap directly or transitively share one dependency_block_id; purge rows are isolated from learning splits and can never bridge them
dependency_contract.fit_tune_evaluation_row: earliest available event in each dependency block
dependency_contract.later_overlapping_events: scored and renderable but excluded from fitting, early stopping, threshold selection, final metrics, permutation inference and matched controls

matching: same outcome horizon, barriers, entry and cost
matched_control.exclusion: control decision bar must be at least 72 bars from every L1 episode for that symbol
matched_control.fallback: Unmatched L1 rows are reported and excluded from paired-control inference; matching rules never relax.

primary_gate.auc_role: diagnostic only; never a pass condition

review.future_outcome_panels: physically separate and never used as model input
